guarantees.claim: st_q is asynchronously forced to StIdle when rst_ni is low; otherwise st_q updates to st_d on every positive edge of clk_i.
guarantees.cond: on posedge clk_i or negedge rst_ni

assumptions.claim: st_d must always be a valid FSM state encoding during normal operation.
assumptions.risk: if st_d is invalid (X or illegal state), st_q could capture an illegal state, potentially corrupting HMAC state machine behavior and compromising security.

assumptions.claim: rst_ni must be asserted low at least once after power-up to initialize st_q to StIdle.
assumptions.risk: without reset, st_q may power up in an unknown state, leading to undefined HMAC operation.

uncertain_points.claim: No recovery mechanism exists if st_d becomes X; st_q would capture X and the FSM could enter an illegal state.
uncertain_points.cond: any clock edge when st_d is X
uncertain_points.risk: illegal state may expose secret keys, produce incorrect MAC results, or cause deadlock.
